note: THE RTFM - the manual, kept as documents. Markdown files in this folder, listed here, shipped with the generator and read in the terminal with /rtfm (src/js/rtfm.js is the reader). These are FOR PATRIKIOS, not for LIA: they are never folded into her memory, never retrieved and never handed to her - the LOREPACK is her recollection, this is the manual for the machine. Everything in this folder is PUBLIC. To add a document: drop the .md file here and list it below (see README.md). `generated: true` means the file is WRITTEN BY THE TERMINAL from another file, not by hand - /rtfm check compares it against a fresh render and says whether the copy has gone stale.
